# @mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font 4.1.3

From npm, integrity `sha512-gzAB3dFHilHX1l5x2xUqRL+1jDQt3Fyza1DkEMVXWC4E8SvsGdlgEza47HYi2WhVcgfkvf4zgUGzuhbq3Pjlew==`, copied by tools/vendor_manim_web.py.

The font ranges MathJax loads on demand (double-struck, calligraphic, fraktur, script, extra arrows and symbols...), for the MathJax 4.1.3 in manim-web's chunk, whose built-in glyphs are this release's. Each file is turned into JSON here (they only call MathJaxNewcmFont.dynamicSetup with glyph data); engine/mw/mathjax.js registers them. Apache-2.0, MathJax Consortium.
